customer_addresses_select_own.name: customer_addresses_select_own
customer_addresses_select_own.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM customers
  WHERE ((customers.id = customer_addresses.customer_id) AND (customers.account_id = ( SELECT current_account_id() AS current_account_id)))))
